blocker.summary: Two supplemental proof surfaces remain contradictory: the selected shell Windows test build never reaches test execution because product-source compilation fails first, and the PowerShell W2Only slice records a raw tracked-script variable-expansion failure plus a later unresolved assertion under a literal-text workaround context.
blocker.details:
Supplemental proof contradiction 1 used the recorded command "cargo test -p shell 'windows_tests::' -- --nocapture" and exited 101 during compile-before-test. The first actionable compiler diagnostics in the captured log are "error[E0432]: unresolved import crate::execution::orchestrator_world_dispatch::PreparedSpawnWorldWorkerBootstrap" at "crates\shell\src\repl\async_repl.rs:150:42", followed by "error[E0412]: cannot find type WorldWorkReceiptRegistry in this scope" in "crates\shell\src\execution\agent_runtime\state_store.rs", and "error[E0425]: cannot find function resolve_internal_dispatch_context" / "enforce_world_dispatch_steering_policy" at "crates\shell\src\execution\orchestrator_world_dispatch.rs:558-559". Existing log evidence therefore places the first contradiction in product-source compilation reached by the selected test build surface, before any windows_tests:: body ran.

Supplemental proof contradiction 2 raw command used "pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/windows/prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1 -W2Only" and exited 1 with "InvalidOperation" at "C:\Users\spmcc\.codex\worktrees\752f\substrate-r2-3\scripts\windows\prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1:2033" and "The variable '$forwarderRelease' cannot be retrieved because it has not been set." Because the raw run used direct -File invocation and the recorded frame is the tracked script file, existing evidence classifies that raw failure as tracked-source execution, not an off-checkout wrapper/extraction. The later literal-text workaround run exited 1 with "Exception" at "C:\Users\spmcc\.codex\worktrees\752f\substrate-r2-3\scripts\windows\prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1:43" and assertion message "start-forwarder.ps1 must still prefer the release forwarder binary." Existing logs do not distinguish whether that second contradiction is accepted-source product drift, tracked-test expectation drift, or workaround-context drift; the already-recorded evidence is insufficient for that classification.
blocker.required_authority: Central meta-orchestrator receipt validation for protocol correctness, plus a new read-only Windows diagnostic evidence dispatch authorized to inspect tracked source and classify the two supplemental contradictions without changing product state.
blocker.handoff_prompt: Run a new native-Windows read-only diagnostic evidence dispatch on commit 58462482126609ad87e59b896f5d22437461d144 limited to the supplemental contradictions: inspect tracked crates/shell compile surfaces and tracked scripts/windows/prefix-mapping-r2-3.Tests.ps1 plus scripts/windows/start-forwarder.ps1, classify whether the shell failure is an accepted-source build break versus selected-target build-surface issue, and classify whether the W2Only contradiction beyond the raw tracked-script variable-expansion failure is product drift, tracked-test expectation drift, or workaround-context drift. Do not recollect base token/WSL mapping evidence and do not mutate product state.
